unit.why: A short anecdote: on a Friday night the tzaddik tells his table that a bird knocked on his door and called him back from rapture to the waiting hasidim.

stories.start_quote: עז סיפר לי הרב החסיד, אשר
stories.summary_en: After Friday-night kiddush the tzaddik tells those at his table that, while alone in his room and so absorbed that he forgot he was in this world, a bird knocked on his door and told him the people at the table were waiting for him.

quotes: אחר קידוש דליל שבת אמר להיושבים על שלחנו
tags.why: The scene is set at the Friday-night table.

quotes: היה נשכח ממני לגמרי שאני בעוה״ז
tags.why: He was so rapt that he forgot this world.

quotes: היה נשכח ממני לגמרי שאני בעוה״ז
tags.why: The tzaddik describes his own mystical absorption.
He was secluded in his room before coming to the table.

quotes: ובא עוף א׳ ודפק על פתחי ואמר
tags.why: A bird speaks to him, apparently a heavenly messenger.

quotes: ובא עוף א׳ ודפק על פתחי ואמר
tags.why: A talking bird is a discrete wondrous event.

quotes: אמר להיושבים על שלחנו, הנה עוף אחד ריחם עליכם
tags.why: The tzaddik tells the event at his Shabbat table.

quotes: כי אנשים היושבים בהשלחן מצפים ביאתך
tags.why: The tzaddik's table with his followers is the setting.
